name: Typeform
description: Typeform is an online forms and surveys platform built around interactive, conversational data-collection experiences with logic, integrations, and branded workflows.
best_for: Marketing, research, and operations teams that want polished interactive forms with conditional logic and workflow integrations.
features: Interactive online forms, surveys, and quizzes
Conversion tracking and drop-off analysis on higher tiers

tiers.name: Free
tiers.notes: Unlimited typeforms with 10 responses per month across the account, plus logic, embedding, exports, and basic design controls according to Typeform's current Help Center.

tiers.name: Basic
tiers.notes: Current monthly list price shown by Typeform. Includes 100 responses per month, one user, unlimited typeforms, AI-powered form creation, conditional logic, webhooks, and integrations.

tiers.name: Plus
tiers.notes: Current monthly list price shown by Typeform. Includes 1,000 responses per month, three users, removal of Typeform branding, and a custom subdomain.

tiers.name: Business
tiers.notes: Current monthly list price shown by Typeform. Includes 10,000 responses per month, five users, drop-off rates, conversion tracking, and priority support.

pros: Free plan supports unlimited forms and core logic for low-volume use
Strong emphasis on interactive form design, conditional paths, embedding, and integrations
Paid tiers scale response volume, collaboration, branding controls, and conversion analytics
cons: The free plan is limited to 10 responses per month across all forms
Response limits remain a central pricing constraint on paid plans
Brand removal, custom subdomains, and broader collaboration require higher tiers

faq.question: Does Typeform have a free plan?
faq.answer: Yes. Typeform's current Free plan supports unlimited typeforms and up to 10 responses per month across the account.

faq.question: How much does Typeform Basic cost?
faq.answer: Typeform's current pricing page lists Basic at $39 per month on monthly billing. The annual option is discounted and may be shown as a lower monthly equivalent.

faq.question: Does Typeform support conditional logic?
faq.answer: Yes. Conditional logic is available for building different paths through forms, and Typeform's current Free plan documentation includes logic among its core capabilities.

alternatives.name: SurveyMonkey
alternatives.description: A survey and feedback platform with broad research tooling, AI-assisted survey creation and analysis, advanced logic, and a large integration ecosystem.
alternatives.best_for: Teams that prioritize structured research, survey methodology, and response analysis

alternatives.name: Jotform
alternatives.description: A no-code form builder with a large template library, payments, conditional logic, workflows, and broad form customization.
alternatives.best_for: Businesses that need operational forms, payments, and high template variety

alternatives.name: Qualtrics
alternatives.description: A research and experience-management survey platform with advanced logic, statistical analysis, dashboards, and enterprise workflows.
alternatives.best_for: Organizations that need advanced research and enterprise survey governance
